description: This PHP interface file defines the contract for Zend Http Client Adapter classes within the Zend Framework. It specifies the required methods for configuring the adapter, connecting to a server, sending requests, reading responses, and closing connections, serving as a blueprint for implementing specific adapter classes.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Interface
classes.description: An interface that mandates the methods for HTTP client adapter implementations in Zend Framework, including configuration, connection, request transmission, response reading, and connection closing.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Set the configuration array for the adapter.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establish a connection to the remote server.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Send an HTTP request to the server.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Read the response from the server.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the connection to the server.
